Software Engineer – Oscilloscope & Measurement Solutions
Colorado Springs, CO
Full-time
Onsite

$90K/yr - $149K/yr
Keysight Technologies develops electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization solutions for technology markets worldwide. The Software Engineer will develop, test, debug, and maintain high-performance software for oscilloscope platforms and electronic measurement solutions, collaborating across software, hardware, QA, manufacturing, and product management teams while contributing to AI-enabled capabilities.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain software for advanced oscilloscope platforms
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, QA, manufacturing, and product management
Develop software that interfaces directly with embedded systems, hardware components, and measurement technologies
Debug and optimize software across the full product lifecycle
Contribute to the integration of AI-enabled capabilities within development workflows and end-user product features
Help define and implement next-generation test and measurement solutions used by engineers worldwide

Required
BS or MS degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
Experience developing software for embedded systems, microcontrollers, or hardware-interfacing applications
Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and software development principles
Experience building, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting software applications
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary engineering environment
Preferred
Experience with modern C++ development
Understanding of digital design, electronic circuits, and electrical engineering fundamentals
Knowledge of analog and mixed-signal circuit design
Hands-on experience with oscilloscopes or electronic test and measurement equipment
Familiarity with FPGA, SoC, robotics, instrumentation, or related hardware technologies
Experience working in Windows and/or Linux development environments
Experience with source control tools such as Git and Bitbucket
Familiarity with engineering collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence
Experience using electronic lab equipment, including oscilloscopes, function generators, power supplies, spectrum analyzers, and digital multimeters
Passion for emerging technologies, including AI-assisted software development
Benefits
Continuous learning opportunities and exposure to cutting-edge technologies.
Relocation is available for this position.
